objective: Repair the measured M373 zero-descriptor replay bottleneck without approximation: SERIAL16 still scans every source row but writes only nonzero fallback/PWP descriptors into a row-ID-carrying compact stream, then replays only active bundles across q32/O4 tiles under the same single-DMA, two-slot, finite-FIFO and stronger bit-sparse baseline.

mechanism.exact_active_rule: write and replay a descriptor iff original16 != 0; zero source rows have mathematically zero Conv contribution and emit no descriptor
mechanism.row_reconstruction: the frozen 48-bit descriptor carries row12, original16, center_index7, distance5, use_pwp1 and flags7
mechanism.matcher_scan: all 3000 rows remain charged through SERIAL16; compaction does not skip matching or inspect future rows
mechanism.write_path: one compact descriptor at each nonzero row retirement, at most one per cycle, directly into alternating descriptor SRAM bank
mechanism.read_path: one compact descriptor bundle per cycle into finite D8 FIFO; every active O4 bundle has at least four SHARED96 service cycles
mechanism.tile_startup: charge one descriptor SRAM read/startup cycle per nonempty tile replay
mechanism.empty_partition: if active_count is zero, suppress both tile payload DMAs and descriptor compute but retain the phase tail and common commit

resource_inheritance: All q32/O4 port, DMA, two-slot, address, descriptor-bank and baseline parameters are inherited byte-for-byte from frozen M373.

decision_rule.advance_to_vcs_scheduler_rtl: At least 1.05x against the reproduced 543,784,143-cycle bit-sparse baseline, exact work conservation, zero DMA/address/capacity violations and independent hammer with no P0/P1.
decision_rule.close: Below 1.05x or any correctness/resource failure closes active descriptor compaction as a performance contribution.

red_lines: M377 must regenerate event timestamps and descriptor byte counts; subtracting M373 zero cycles without replay is insufficient.
Do not skip SERIAL16 matching of zero rows.
Do not call the M373 1.081121x arithmetic preview an admitted M377 result.
